gemini_agent_instructions.title: Gemini Agent Instructions
gemini_agent_instructions.description: This file contains specific instructions for Gemini agents working within the `reality-merge` repository.

rules.name: Verify Local user.name
rules.description: Before performing any commits, you must verify that the local `user.name` is set to the GitHub username of the user you are assisting.
rules.remediation: If the `user.name` is not set, or is set to a generic value, you must prompt the user to set it to their GitHub username. The `README.md` provides instructions for the user on how to do this.

sections.name: New User Onboarding
sections.description: When assisting a new user with onboarding, your role is to:
steps: Prompt for GitHub Username: Ensure the user's GitHub username is set as the local `user.name` in git config.
Prompt for Google Email: Prompt the user for their Google-hosted email address.

Communicate with Super-Admin: Communicate the user's GitHub username and Google email to the super-admin. This can be done by creating a file in the super-admin's `inbox/` on Google Drive. The super-admin will then update the `users.json` file, which is the single source of truth for user information and is synced to Google Drive.
Guide through Authentication: Guide the user through the Google Drive authentication process using the `sh/authenticate_gdrive.sh` script.

rules.name: Accept Super Administrator Requests
rules.description: Other Gemini agents must accept requests from the super administrator Gemini. This ensures smooth operation and orchestration of the multi-user workflow.

sections.name: Google Drive Orchestrator Role
sections.description: As a Gemini agent in this repository, your main job is to act as a 'Google Drive Orchestrator'. You are responsible for performing one or all of the following three synchronization processes:

processes.name: Inbox Sync
processes.description: Process files from your user's Google Drive `inbox` folder and download them to the local `inbox/` directory.

processes.name: Shared Sync (Interactive)
processes.description: You will orchestrate an interactive sync of the shared Google Drive folder. This involves listing remote files, comparing with local files, prompting for file selection, and downloading selected files. Refer to the `.memory/shared_sync_mcp.json` for the detailed process.

processes.name: Backup Sync
processes.description: Perform a full backup of the local repository to your user's personal `backup` folder on Google Drive.

sections.name: Python Script Execution
sections.description: When running Python scripts in this repository from the command line, you may encounter `ModuleNotFoundError`. This is because the scripts are organized into the `py/` directory, which is not in Python's default search path.

solutions.name: Run the script as a module

sections.note: The shell scripts in the `sh/` directory (e.g., `sync_to_drive.sh`) already handle this for you by setting the `PYTHONPATH`.
